overview: Blueprints are formulas that must be learned before you can craft a piece of furniture, a structure, or certain gear. Once learned, a blueprint appears under the 'Special' tab of your inventory and its item becomes placeable in Build Mode.
howToObtain: Looting chests, dumpsters and cabinets in the world (lootable containers reset on a global timer, refreshing every 4 hours).
Disassembling unwanted or duplicate blueprints at the Designer's Workstation (Building tab of the Memetic menu) for Formula Blueprint Fragments, which can be redeemed for new ones.
Purchasing from the in-game Shop or seasonal Shop rotations.
Rewarded from Memetic Specializations in the Building and Crafting branches (many specializations directly unlock a blueprint, e.g. turrets, traps, storage crates and workbenches).
Deviant assistance — e.g. the Logging Beaver deviant can occasionally find furniture items while foraging.

notableConstructionUpdate: Patch 3.0.2 (July 22, 2026) added flexible snap-point switching for walls, ceilings, roofs, stairs and pillars, giving builders finer control when placing blueprints.
